title: When Do Annotator Demographics Matter? Measuring the Influence of Annotator Demographics with the POPQUORN Dataset
reasoning: The paper examines how annotator demographics influence perceptions of offensiveness and politeness, which are social constructs, but it does not evaluate or benchmark specific ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/spiritual topics.
